name: malformed-config
description: The web service won't start after a config change — it's crashing on startup and is down. Get it serving again.
bugs: config/settings.json has a trailing comma after the last key, so it is not valid JSON and json.loads raises JSONDecodeError
once the JSON parses, workers is set to 0, which fails the workers >= 1 startup check
correct_diagnosis: config/settings.json was invalid JSON (a trailing comma after the last key) and set workers to 0; removing the trailing comma and setting a positive worker count lets the service start.

reference_fix.description: Make settings.json valid JSON and set a positive worker count.
